{{Youmay|the [[New Regime]] Inner Council|[[Inner Council (disambiguation)|another use of the word]]}}
The '''Inner Council''' was the ruling contingent of the [[New Regime]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]], prior to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. It was this council who issued the Regime's mandates, and met with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] delegates and [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] representatives to resolve all issues concerning Brigia.
